title: Generic prepared number-field authentication
objective: Generalize prepared number-field exact authentication from the cubic sentinel to degree/signature-generic frozen development fields in degrees 3 through 5, with explicit unsupported cases and adversarial mutation coverage

oracles: Exact prepared-number-field identities and frozen exporter data

runs.result: pass: legacy cubic authority, typed-export round trip, and 17 mutations
pass: all 16 manifest-bound development exports and 42 cross-degree mutations

handoff.summary: Generalized prepared-field authentication from the real-cubic sentinel to the complete frozen 16-field development export across degrees 3, 4, and 5. Exact checks now cover resultant discriminants, Sturm signatures, modular irreducibility certificates, arbitrary n-by-n basis and inverse data, all n-cubed multiplication constants, real and complex embedding identities, PARI M-to-G realification, rounded embeddings, and runtime tables. The directory checker binds 608 MB of external payloads to manifest abe10f55..., confirms no reserve was opened and no answer-bearing event affects authority, and rejects 42 representative mutations. The legacy resident cubic and its 17 mutations still pass.
risks: The exact irreducibility proof is deliberately a bounded modular certificate: a valid irreducible polynomial with no irreducible reduction through prime 257 is explicitly unsupported.
W0 requires at least one real embedding so roots of unity are exactly plus/minus one; totally imaginary fields need a different exact torsion certificate.

Focused Linux validation passed. Cross-platform broad suites were deferred because this host-only JavaScript verifier has no product runtime or native-code change; a full build was still running at handoff.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this commit after the development exporter commit so the compact manifest and verifier land together.
Call authenticatePreparedBundle before allocating or invoking every generalized development-field native root.
Keep the eight reserve payloads unopened until the frozen candidate gate.
